{"id":2016480603,"question_id":4316,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month, 3 weeks","timestamp":1780063180,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2016480603/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Swaps to Move Zeros to End","memory":"31.6 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int minimumSwaps(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int zeros = 0;\n        for(auto it : nums) if(it == 0) zeros++;\n\n        int steps = 0;\n        for(int i = nums.size()-1 ; i>=0 ; i--)\n        {\n            if(zeros == 0) break;\n            if(nums[i] != 0) \n            {\n                steps++;\n            }\n            zeros--;\n        }\n        return steps;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-swaps-to-move-zeros-to-end","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2039}
